question: The shipped chain-disagreement warning (WP44 ChainWarning: D1 end-of-warmup step, D2/D3 one-sided median log-density gap vs the chains' median, D4 leave-one-chain-out R-hat) missed 3 of 3 two-versus-two mode splits in WP69's two-mode arm while R-hat > 1.01 caught all 12 second-mode cell-arms. Can a split-aware check, added to the shipped warning, report every multi-modal split (3-1 and 2-2) without new false positives and without losing any warning the shipped rule gives?
machine: lane 4 of the shared c7a.4xlarge box (Ubuntu 24.04, Rust 1.88.0), every build and cell under taskset -c 12-15, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, TMPDIR under ~/lanes/chain_disagreement_splits_v1/; pinned, co-tenanted (other lanes active); walls are not evidence
library: main at the worktree base (90540b21, WP69 merged); no library change; the candidate checks live in the harness (src/split_rules.rs) and read finished runs only

posteriordb.access: read-only shared checkout; reference draws read directly from reference_posteriors/draws/draws/*.json.zip

rules.current: ChainWarning::from_chains (shipped): D1 WarmupStep, D2 WarmupLogDensity, D3 SampledLogDensity, D4 RHat; NonfinitePositions recorded but is not a disagreement check
rules.S_split_rhat: primary candidate. >= 4 chains and all-chain max rank R-hat (diagnostics::rhat over every ChainOutput sample coordinate, NaN-ignoring max) > 1.01. Score every partition into two groups of >= 2 chains; a partition agrees iff max R-hat within each group <= 1.01. Fires iff some partition agrees; reports the agreeing partition with the smallest larger-group maximum and names its smaller group (equal groups: the lower mean retained-draw median log density; tie/undefined: the group without chain 0).
rules.G_density_clusters: secondary candidate. On the last slow warmup window and on the retained draws, with D2/D3 preconditions (>= 3 chains, windows >= 10 transitions, finite medians and IQRs): sort chain medians, cut where the neighbour gap > 3 x median within-chain IQR; with >= 2 clusters name every chain outside the reference cluster (largest; size tie: highest medians). Two-sided.
rules.candidate_warning: shipped disagreement checks plus the candidate check (additive). Candidate S warning chains = current disagreement chains U S named; candidate G = current U G named (either window).

gates.note: v7 gates (ArviZ 0.23.4 rank R-hat, bulk ESS, tail ESS (0.05/0.95) on every posteriordb reference parameter); a cell that errors or times out fails every gate. Replay cells of models without a posteriordb reference (funnel10, seeds_centered, radon) are not scored.

definitions.off_chain: a chain whose retained mean is more than 3 reference SD off the posteriordb reference mean on some reference parameter (WP44/WP69 'wrong' / 'second-mode' chain)
definitions.split_two_mode: a two-mode cell whose chains do not all end in the same mode (end mode = majority of retained draws, WP69 harness); 3-1 if one chain ends apart, 2-2 if two do
definitions.split_hmm: an hmm_drive_0 cell with at least one off chain; 3-1 if one, 2-2 if two
definitions.reported: the candidate warning (shipped disagreement checks plus the candidate check) names at least one chain on the cell
definitions.new_warning: the candidate check itself (S or G) fires on the cell, whether or not the shipped checks also fire
definitions.false_positive: a new_warning on an arm (ii) cell that passes every gate
definitions.regression: on an arm (iii) cell, a chain named by the shipped disagreement checks is not named by the candidate warning

decision.i: every fresh split cell of arm (i) (blocks I) is reported, and at least one fresh 2-2 split occurred (otherwise (i) is not tested and nothing is proposed)
decision.ii: zero false positives over the 51 arm (ii) cells
decision.iii: zero regressions over the 26 arm (iii) cells
decision.propose: PROPOSE S iff (i), (ii), (iii) hold for S; otherwise PROPOSE G iff they hold for G; otherwise DO NOT PROPOSE. A proposal is a ChainWarning change (a new observe-only variant), not a kernel change; draws are unchanged.
decision.implementation_check: on every completed cell the harness's recorded shipped warnings equal Posterior::chain_warnings() / Summary::chain_warnings text for text; a mismatch means FAILED (implementation)
